text: The praises of the man Our predecessors, their memory to blessing, said that stood is harder than went and sat is harder than all of them. If so, the insulters will be worse than sinners. And Rabbi Moshe the Kohen explained to the contrary, and said that the intention of did not stand is "didn't even stand". And according to my understanding, that the word wicked are those who do not stand on one standard(?)...
Streams From the root of divide their language (Psalm 55:10) ...

As the chaff The fine [chaff] from the straw; as the chaff that is driven with the wind out of the threshing-floor (Hoshea 13:3). And behold, the soul of the righteous is likened to the grain that stands, and the wicked are like the straw before the wind.

Because He knows There is no doubt that [His] Honored Name knows the generalities and the particulars; the generalities being the soul of every living thing for all the creations; and the particulars being every species by itself, or even every being by itself, for they all are the work of His hands; only the knowledge of the particular for every one in general, both for righteousness and for evil we know, and forever...
Take a stand with the nations, the kings and the...
And against his messiah that they shouldn't deny to him...
We shall disconnect their bindings
From the root of...
He who sits
Since he mentioned The kings of the Earth take a stand, he said opposed to them: He who sits in the skies, for they are above, over the man.
The Gaon said that the intention of will laugh is that He will put them to laughter and to ridicule. And the correct [explanation is] that [His] Name created ...
Then

There are those who say: y'daber is like: He will destroy; like: (2 Chronicles 22:10) and she destroyed all the royal seed, which is a language of death, like: (Hoshea 13:14) Ho, thy plagues, O death; like: and she destroyed all the royal seed, for it is written in a different book...
And I crowned

I Kinged. And the intention is that he is My prince, as the five kings of Midian, which were (Joshua 13:21): princes of Sihon. And know that the construct state sometimes is from the honored to the contemptible, and its opposite, as (Psalm 44:5): You are my King God...
Ask
It is the custom of the father to bequeath [to] the son. Therefore He said: and I will give nations, your bequest.
The ends of Earth
From the root of (Genesis 47:15): for our money ended; places which are cut off from [human] settlement.
With a staff of iron
The sword.
You shall scatter them
As opposed to: nations assemble.
And now, kings
They are the kings of the Earth. And wise up is the opposite of: against God. And be restricted is the opposite of: their bindings. And judges of the land are rulers.
Work
The opposite of their words: We shall disconnect. And working [His] Name is to fear from Him...
God, how
In the holy tongue, it falls [both] on an honored thing and a contemptible one...
Of my soul [literally, to my soul]
About my soul; as the way of (Shemot 14:3): And Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel; (Bereishit 20:13): say of me: He is my brother.
Salvation
[This word has] two signs [of] feminine language; a way of lucidity as (Shemot 15:16): Terror; (Psalm 120:1): In distress. ...
And you. A Shield

A noun; and it's not a verb, for it would have been proper for it to be on the derivation pattern of (Jeremiah 21:4): "Behold! I am turning back". And the intention of a Shield is that he does not come in war. And the intention of my Honor is because whoever wins has honor.
My voice
And the intention is: I will not come in war, But I will raise my voice in prayer.
From the mountain of His Holiness
Because of the Ark which was in Zion, it was called the mountain of holiness. And this was before the matter of Araunah, the Jebusite.
Have set [themselves] against me
Like: (Isaiah 22:7) set [themselves] toward the gate; like: waged war. And there are those who explained: the foundations; and the meaning is like nets; hence the word all around.
To God the salvation

For He Will Save whom He Will Want to. And the meaning of upon Your nation – those are the ones who fight for David, for they are truthfully the nation of God, and not so those who help the son to conspire against his father. And he prayed that God should bless them and there should lack not one man of them in war; or he prophesied.
For the Leader; to the Nehiloth

To is like upon in meaning, like (1 Samuel 1:10): And she prayed unto God; For this child (1 Samuel 1:27) is the opposite. And the Aleph will not be changed with an Ayin; only the letters Aleph, He, Waw, Yodh are those that get changed with each other, and Sin with Samekh, for they are close in origin.
God
The meaning of morning – every morning, like (Lamentations 3:23): New in the mornings...
Shall not
The meaning of shall stand – like the way of the servants that stand on their king.
You shall destroy. A man of blood and deceit
He is the talebearer, like (Jeremiah 9:7): Their tongue is a sharpened arrow, deceit…
God shall abhor
God is the subject. And the meaning – that he is abhorred in His eyes, and despised.

And I – returns to what he began (5:4): [In the] morning You shall hear my voice; that he comes into the House of God and does not have with himself an offering to bow down in His Temple, like one who brings of the first of the fruit of the ground, that is written there (Deuteronomy 26:10): And you shall bow yourself before God Your Lord. And the meaning is: I have no offering, only to give thanks in the abundance of Your loving-kindness upon me.

And the meaning of in Your fear – I do not have with what to bow myself, only with my fear of You, like the way of (Exodus 20:17): And that His fear shall be upon your faces, for the others shall fear of God.
God
The beginning of my prayer – that You shall lead me in the way of Your righteousness.
Because of those observing me

For I shall fear that my leg will stumble and You will punish me, then those observing me will rejoice. And its meaning is from the root of (Numbers 24:17): I shall observe him, but not near; like (1 Samuel 18:9): Eyed David; those who look out for a bad day.
And the word make straight – like (Genesis 8:17): Let them go out with you.
For there isn't in his mouth
In the mouth of each one of them; like (Jeremiah 31:14): Weeps for her children; she has refused to be comforted, because he is not. And ...
Their inward part
That is the heart which is concealed.
An open grave
An immediate disaster.
They will make smooth
From the root of (Genesis 27:11): ...
Hold them guilty (האשימם)
The Aleph is from the root; or it is substituted as the Yodh of תישמנה (Ezekiel 6:6); as in (Genesis 47:19): And the land be not desolate.
And the meaning of by their counsels – for their counsel will make them fall.
And they shall rejoice
The meaning of and You shall shelter them – since he mentioned those that take refuge in You. ...
For
This verse is connected to the previous one; that those that love Your name shall exult in You when they see that you will banish the wicked and bless the righteous.

There are those who say: You shall encompass him – from the light construction; like (1 Samuel 23:26): compass David. And the correct [explanation]: that it's from the additional construction like (1 Samuel 17:25)...
